scope: IPC capability and endpoint payload nodes join pending-call and reply-token nodes in the existing ipc_nodes requested-byte/count pool. Each node retains backing and its optional logical reservation through preparation, hidden results, detached cleanup and actual deallocation. No new metadata pool, holder allocation, cleanup registry, SDK or wire change.
artifact_note: Runtime Rust sources were frozen before all native campaigns. Later documentation changes can alter tracked-diff identities; per-file source and archived artifact hashes identify the exercised code. Service/SDK sources are unchanged; current signed version-10 bundles from the prior IPC node qualification were reused. Each runner regenerated signed security fixtures.

policy.decision: Increase backing bytes from 6/8 MiB to 12/16 MiB and slots from 18432/24576 to 73728/98304 to accommodate the expanded family while preserving existing logical resource ceilings. A conservative all-IPC unified-capability mix plus all pending/reply/endpoint records requests about 8.03/10.70 MiB and 62208/82944 nodes, leaving layout/candidate headroom and a quarter reserve for trusted admission. Sharing avoids another pool/admin category but increases same-class competition. Higher limits permit more retained heap consumption; lower limits can reject otherwise valid logical resources. No RAM is preallocated and independent ceilings do not establish simultaneous RAM fit or sustained progress.

classification.capability: PreparedReservation captures backing_platform from the exact recipient authority namespace before authority metadata allocation, retains that scalar in its complete owner and exposes a borrowed accessor. IPC payload construction borrows this same captured class; no extra registry lock or later ASID lookup. Connection logical sponsorship remains its original grantor/requester record charge, separately from recipient backing.
classification.endpoint: Existing exact-root validation and endpoint/queue reservation capture platform before node allocation. The complete endpoint preparation passes this original class unchanged even after promotion.
classification.pending_reply: Existing original call-record class remains unchanged; its nodes and any capability payload can have independently captured backing classification.
classification.lifetime: Typed Charge<R> owns NodeCharge<IpcNodes> and optional logical R in the same node. Binding later logical admission cannot replace backing. Actual payload/node deallocation precedes refund; preparation rejection explicitly cancels after local guards, root last. Complete containing fallback retains all fields under unknown IPC/heap/pool guards. No resource privilege, physical completion or replay authority is added.

wire.change: None: existing ipc_nodes row reports expanded coverage/current limits; catalog IDs, widths, SDK, syscall registers and signed runtime ABI are unchanged.
